metadata.title: Ascendant Professional Seed: 2026 Strategic Standards
metadata.notes: Closing the gap for the most strategic and high-growth professional roles.

nodes.title: Prompt Engineering Specialist Certification
nodes.description: Designing, optimizing, and securing prompts for Large Language Models. Mastering few-shot, chain-of-thought, and adversarial prompting. Linked to Conceptual Blending.

nodes.title: GARP Sustainability and Climate Risk (SCR)
nodes.description: Climate change risk management, policy, and reporting. Understanding physical and transition risks in the global economy. Linked to Planetary Repair.

nodes.title: GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
nodes.description: Advanced incident response and digital forensics. Analysis of memory, file systems, and network logs. Mapping Epistemic Witness to professional forensics.

nodes.title: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR)
nodes.description: Standards for the safe handling and transport of dangerous goods by air. Identification, classification, and packaging. Linked to Material Stewardship.

nodes.title: Board Certified Telehealth Professional
nodes.description: Foundations of telehealth delivery. Legal, ethical, and clinical standards for remote patient care. Linked to Bioregional Vitality.

edges.rationale: Conceptual blending and linguistic sovereignty provide the cognitive basis for effective prompt engineering.
Planetary repair capstones provide the physical context for climate risk assessment.
Epistemic witness training provides the ethical and logical grounding required for high-stakes digital forensics.
